apikeys_create_step1_subtitle: Step 1 of 2: Create the key and set account-wide permissions. Step 2 configures permissions for each keyring.
apikeys_expiration_hint: Set when this key should stop working automatically.
apikeys_keyrings_modal_subtitle: Set global API key permissions plus granular permissions per linked keyring.
apikeys_legend_apikeys_body: Decide whether this API key can only be used itself, or also manage other API keys in this tenant.
apikeys_legend_datakeys_body: Pick whether the key can only view data keys, rotate them, or remove older data key material for a specific keyring.
apikeys_legend_keyrings_body: Choose whether this API key can only view keyrings, manage their settings, or remove keyrings.
apikeys_legend_ops_body: Enable only the operations this integration needs, such as encrypt, decrypt, rewrap, sign, verify, and HMAC generation.
apikeys_name_hint: Give this key a clear label so teammates know which integration uses it.
apikeys_page_subtitle: Manage tenant API keys and their permissions.
apikeys_perm_apikeys_write: Create, edit, and rotate API keys
apikeys_r_apikeys_hint: Controls what this key can do to API key records in this tenant.
apikeys_r_keyrings_hint: Controls global keyring access. Per-keyring permissions configured in step 2 take precedence over this setting.
apikeys_step1_complete_body: Your API key was created. Copy the secret now, then continue to keyring access.
error_message_access_denied: This service is invite-only. You need an invitation from an existing member to sign in.
error_message_configuration: There is a problem with the server configuration. Please contact support if the issue persists.
error_message_default: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
error_message_verification: The sign-in link is no longer valid. It may have been used already or it may have expired.
login_email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
login_email_sent: Check your email for a magic link to sign in.
team_onboarding_byo_warning: This service should have its own project, machine account, and access token to prevent cross-contamination and leakage of secrets. Do not directly manipulate the secrets inside the project or you may break it.
team_onboarding_form_error: Something went wrong. Please check your inputs.
team_onboarding_instruction_1: Log in to your online web vault
team_onboarding_instruction_2: On the left navigation, go to "Secrets Manager", then "Projects"
team_onboarding_instruction_3: Click "+ New" in the top right, choose "Project", and give it a name
team_onboarding_instruction_4: On the left navigation, go to "Machine accounts"
team_onboarding_instruction_5: Click "+ New" in the top right, choose "Machine account", and give it a name
team_onboarding_instruction_6: Under the "Projects" tab, choose the project you created, click "Add", and set permissions to "Can read, write". Then click save.
team_onboarding_instruction_7: Under the "Access tokens" tab, click "+ Create access token", name it, and set expiration to your preference
team_onboarding_instruction_8: Copy the generated token and paste it in the "Access Token" field below
team_onboarding_instruction_9: Select the project you created earlier from the "Project" dropdown
team_onboarding_jurisdiction_help: This is where we store your data (login info, logs and encrypted BYO connection info) and connect to Bitwarden from
team_onboarding_projects_enter_credentia: Enter endpoints and API key first
team_onboarding_region_cloud_hint: Keys are stored in your own Bitwarden cloud account, but managed by this platform. Recommended for most teams.
team_onboarding_region_custom_hint: Keys are stored in your self-hosted server, but managed by this platform. Recommended for advanced teams.
team_onboarding_subtitle: Set up a new team with encryption key management.
team_onboarding_vault_help: This is where the actual encryption keys are stored for us to do normal operations with
team_onboarding_vault_managed_hint: Keys are stored and managed by the platform. No configuration needed. Not recommended for production.
team_page_subtitle: Select a team to manage keys and encryption.
users_page_subtitle: Manage team members and their permissions.
vault_approval_body_delete: Approving this permanently destroys every keyring and data key. Anything encrypted with them becomes unrecoverable.
vault_approval_body_transfer: Approving this copies every keyring and data key into the new vault, then removes them from the old one. The team keeps working throughout.
vault_approval_denied: This change needs more permission than you have. Ask a team admin to approve it.
vault_approval_done: The migration has started. It runs in the background and may take a while.
vault_approval_failed: The migration could not be started.
vault_approval_title: A vault migration is waiting for your approval
vault_config_approval_notice_delete: This is irreversible and needs approval by email. Only team admins will get a link, and it stays valid for 15 minutes.
vault_config_approval_notice_transfer: This needs approval by email. Anyone on this team who can edit team settings will get a link that stays valid for 15 minutes.
vault_config_body: Move this team onto a different secret vault, or update the credentials we use to reach the current one. We never show you the stored access token, so any change means entering it again.
vault_config_change_connection: You are pointing this team at a different server or project. Your existing keyrings and data keys will not follow on their own.
vault_config_change_mode: You are moving this team to a different vault. Your existing keyrings and data keys will not follow on their own.
vault_config_change_token: Only the access token changes. This is applied straight away.
vault_config_failed: The vault settings could not be saved.
vault_config_needs_write: Changing the vault needs write access to team settings.
vault_config_new_id_notice: This creates a new team behind the scenes and moves everything into it. The team keeps its name, members, API keys and access, but this page's URL will change once the migration finishes - update any bookmarked links.
vault_config_saved_manual: The vault connection has been updated.
vault_config_saved_pending: Approval requested. We emailed a link to {recipients} team members.
vault_config_saved_token: The access token has been updated.
vault_config_strategy_delete_hint: Every keyring and data key is permanently destroyed. Anything encrypted with them becomes unrecoverable.
vault_config_strategy_manual_hint: The keys are already in the new location. We only update where we look for them.
vault_config_strategy_title: What should happen to the keys you already have?
vault_config_strategy_transfer_hint: Every keyring and data key is copied into the new vault, then removed from the old one.
vault_config_token_hint: Enter the access token again, even if it hasn't changed.
vault_no_access: You don't have permission to view this team's vault settings.
vault_page_subtitle: Where this team's key material is stored, and how to rebuild its index from the vault.
vault_rescan_body: Reads every secret this team owns in the vault and rebuilds the keyring and data key index from it. Use this if the index has drifted from what the vault actually holds.
vault_rescan_detail_derive: Algorithm, key size and hash are derived from each stored key; creation and rotation times come from the ids themselves.
vault_rescan_detail_names: A keyring that has to be recreated gets a placeholder name — its original name only ever lived in this index, never in the vault.
vault_rescan_detail_nondestructive: Nothing is deleted or overwritten: existing names, algorithms and rotation policies are left exactly as you set them.
vault_rescan_detail_schedules: Rotation schedules are not rebuilt. A recreated keyring has time-based rotation enabled but no schedule until its next rotation.
vault_rescan_empty: No key material for this team was found in the vault.
vault_rescan_needs_write: Rescanning needs write access to both keyrings and data keys.
vault_storage_byo_hint: Keys are held in the Bitwarden organization you connected during onboarding. We only store the connection to it.
vault_storage_managed_hint: Keys are held in our Bitwarden Secrets Manager organization, in your team's jurisdiction.
verify_hint: You can close this window or return to the login page.
verify_message: A sign-in link has been sent to your email address.
